instruction: Start from `/home/user/Desktop/shutdown.fst`, `/home/user/Desktop/servo_shutdown_base.dat`, and an NREL 5 MW dependency set. Complete a fully specified normal-shutdown simulation from the command line. OpenFAST 5.0 tight coupling does not support the ServoDyn high-speed-shaft mechanical brake, so this task uses generator disconnection and collective feathering only. 1. Write `/home/user/Desktop/build_case.py`. Create `/home/user/Desktop/inflow_shutdown.dat` with steady `HWindSpeed=15 m/s`. Create normalized `/home/user/Desktop/elasto_shutdown.dat` with initial `RotSpeed=12.1 rpm`, output channels `BldPitch1`, `BldPitch2`, `BldPitch3`, and `RotSpeed`, and create normalized `/home/user/Desktop/aero_shutdown.dat`. 2. Create `/home/user/Desktop/servo_shutdown.dat` from the template. Set `GenTiStp=True`, `TimGenOf=20 s`, and `HSSBrMode=0`. For all three blades set `TPitManS=20 s`, `PitManRat=2 deg/s`, and `BlPitchF=90 deg`. Retain the `GenPwr` output channel. 3. Create `/home/user/Desktop/shutdown_case.fst` with `TMax=90 s`, `DT_Out=0.1 s`, `OutFileFmt=1`, and references to the generated files. Run `/home/user/miniconda3/bin/openfast shutdown_case.fst`, retain `/home/user/Desktop/shutdown_case.out`, and save the console output as `/home/user/Desktop/shutdown_case.log`; require normal termination. 4. Write `/home/user/Desktop/postprocess.py`. From the native output, report: (a) elapsed time from 20 s to the first sample at or after 20 s with `abs(GenPwr) < 100 kW`; (b) elapsed time from 20 s to the first sample at or after 20 s at which all three blade-pitch channels are at least 89.9 deg; and (c) absolute `RotSpeed` at the final 90 s sample. Save exactly one CSV row to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` as `power_below_100_time_s,full_feather_time_s,final_rotor_speed_rpm`, using six decimal places. Do not use GUI tools.
